IA2 SMG.description:
A prototype SMG based off of the Selvazian IA2 platform for use with law-enforcement, designed as a potential replacement for the IMBEL MT-40.

Possesses a relatively modest rate of fire with above-average damage and snappy handling.
IA2 SMG.name: IA2 SMG

MP7.description:
The X46A2 was a response to the a new push to develop more compact cartridges. With a higher-than-average penetration for its class, low recoil, blazingly fast RPM, and impressive ergonomics, the X46A2 is a great all-arounder in nearly every situation.
Pick up that can.

Model submitted by Rialag.
MP7.name: MP7

COLT SMG 635.description:
A compact M16A1-derived SMG chambered in 9x19mm. Designed for discreet operations and close-quarters engagements, it features an incredibly high rate of fire and relatively impressive handling.

Why did the energy department need one of these again?
COLT SMG 635.name: COLT SMG 635

attachmentModifiers.info: A heavy hydralic buffer that slows down the rate of fire of the M635 to a slightly more controllable level, providing better recoil control.

MP10.description: Largely regarded as a failure, the SMX-10 was a private company's attempt to modernize the SMX-9 with integrated rails and a flashlight-holding foregrip. The SMX-10 maintains greater damage retention over range, but sacrifices close range performance.
MP10.name: MP10

AUG A3 PARA.description:
A paratrooper model of the UAR A3, chambered in 9mm. Slightly reduced magazine size compared to most other PDWs, but features impressive recoil control.

Model submitted by Rialag.
AUG A3 PARA.name: AUG A3 PARA

MAC10.description:
A Grand Federation PDW that fires .45 ACP at a blisteringly high rate of fire. Very lightweight. Poor accuracy while aimed, with stable hip-fire characteristics.

Remodel submitted by Vic.
MAC10.name: MAC10

UMP45.description:
Designed as a replacement to the SMX-9, the PDX-45 is a heavy-hitting, low recoil-oriented platform that lends itself to consistently good performance. With great damage, great mobility, and decent recoil, the PDX-45 is a good choice for all purposes.

Model submitted by Rialag.
UMP45.name: UMP45

I MP-9.description:
An extremely simple Nordhelm designed submachine gun, intended for military and police applications. Without any government interest, the gun was later redesigned and simplified for the civilian market into what is known as the KG-99 and TEC-9 today. Very few examples of the MP-9 were ever made, with estimates at around 25 or even fewer. High rate of fire with controllable recoil and excellent handling, but somewhat poor damage.

Model submitted by Vic.
I MP-9.name: I MP-9

M3A1.description:
The M3A1, affectionately known as the Grease Gun as a result of its unique shape, is an iconic World War II SMG. Renowned for being made cheaply, its low-RPM, low-recoil, but very high damage nevertheless make it an impressive option.

Model submitted by Vic.
M3A1.name: M3A1

K7.description:
A Seongho submachine gun stemming from the K1A rifle. It has fast handling, a high firerate and is very stable, however this stability is a tradeoff for its poor range performance...
What do you mean you want to use muzzle devices on it?
K7.name: K7

PPSH-41.description: Known affectionately as Papasha by Zarovian troops during World War II, the PPSH-41 features an extremely large magazine for its size. Its great weight and 7.62x25mm Tokarev cartridge means poor mobility and middling recoil, but its 1250 RPM means you'll never be wanting for more ammunition. Until you run out, at least.
PPSH-41.name: PPSH-41

KRISS VECTOR.description: Powered by its unique downward inertial block recoil system, the Vector is known for its impressively low recoil despite its extremely high rate of fire and its larger-than-most pistol cartridge. Its recoil system lends itself to incredible up-close performance, but its awkward pattern and .45ACP ammo type mean it suffers at range.
KRISS VECTOR.name: KRISS VECTOR
